hook: Down syndrome lymph nodes have few germinal centers, which may explain faulty antibody maturation
summary: People with Down syndrome have both more autoimmunity and weaker immunity. Infant lymph nodes showed far fewer germinal centers and fewer supporting stromal cells, and adult memory B cells carried fewer mutations and more of an autoreactivity-linked gene. The link from lymph node structure to the B cell changes is inferred, and sample sizes are not stated in the abstract.
title: Dysregulated B Cell Education Drives Autoimmunity and Immunodeficiency in Down Syndrome
